map.220−年龄是人群均值，个体差异±10–12 bpm；更准可用 Tanaka 2: 220 − age is a population average with an individual spread of ±10-12 bpm; Tanaka 208 − 0.7 × age is more accurate. This tool estimates the upper bound from 220 − age and brings the resting heart rate into the personalised zones.
map.Karvonen 以「最大心率−静息心率」为基准再加静息，比单纯最大心率百分比更: Karvonen uses "maximum heart rate − resting heart rate" as the base and then adds the resting rate, which is more personalised than a plain percentage of maximum heart rate. Someone with a low resting rate (good cardiorespiratory fitness) gets more accurate zones, avoiding a one-size-fits-all approach.
